name: Hennepin Healthcare hospital volunteers (ages 16 and up)
what_you_do: Help out at a big trauma hospital in downtown Minneapolis. Most new helpers start at the front, showing patients and guests where to go. Later you can move to other parts of the hospital.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 and up. You should be reliable, helpful and respectful of all people.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Free ramp parking while you volunteer.
duration: Start with a 4-hour shift once a week for 8 weeks. The yearly minimum is 40 to 80 hours, depending on whether you are a high school student, college student or adult.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Apply any time and finish the steps within 6 weeks.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Then you meet with the volunteer office, turn in your shot records and TB test, and get your fingerprints taken. Last, you take a short class online.
notes: When you finish, you can ask them to be a job reference. Volunteer office: 612-873-2512 or volunteerservices@hcmed.org. It is at 900 South 8th Street in Minneapolis.
